fields.name: Name
fields.noFolder: No folders. Add at least one.
fields.serverPaths: Folders on the server “{server}”, not on this computer.
fields.realtimeDesc: The server notices added or deleted files right away, without waiting for a scan.

add.title: New Library
add.serverNote: Pick folders on the server “{server}”. These are its disks and network shares, not this computer’s.
add.needFolder: At least one folder is needed.
add.nameTaken: A library already has this name.

browser.title: Choose a Server Folder
browser.onServer: You are browsing the disks of the server “{server}”.
browser.hint: Open a folder and choose it, or type a path and press Enter to open it.

editor.title: Edit “{name}”
editor.refreshIntervalDesc: The server periodically re-reads online metadata.
editor.saveLocal: Save Artwork and Metadata into Media Folders
editor.saveLocalDesc: Handy to get metadata back if the library is recreated.
editor.fetchersDesc: Turn on the sources to use. Sources higher in the list win.
editor.noFetcher: No sources available for this type.
editor.embeddedTitlesDesc: Uses the title stored in the file when there is no online metadata.
editor.chapterImagesDesc: One thumbnail per chapter, shown in the chapter menu.
editor.trickplayDesc: The images shown when hovering the progress bar.
editor.skipEmbedded: Skip If the File Already Has Subtitles
editor.skipAudioMatch: Skip If the Audio Is in That Language
editor.perfectMatchDesc: Only subtitles made for this exact file are kept.
editor.seriesGroupingDesc: Folders of the same show are merged into one.
editor.embeddedEpisodesDesc: Uses the season and episode numbers stored in the file.
editor.introDetectionDesc: Finds opening credits so they can be skipped.
editor.needPath: A library needs at least one folder.

remove.label: Delete {name}

remove.body: “{name}” will disappear from the server, with its metadata and the watch history of its items.
remove.filesKept: Your media files are not deleted: they stay in their folders on the server.
